topbar.companiesPhase: Admin adds the companies, GSTINs, branches and places in Phase 1. Then you can switch between them here.
topbar.fyPhase: Financial years and periods are set up per company in Phase 1. The current year (April to March, IST) is shown.
topbar.scopePhase: Choose both companies, one company or one place once companies are set up (Phase 1).
topbar.searchPlaceholder: Search anything — documents, items, parties, serial numbers…
topbar.searchPhase: Search across documents, items and parties arrives with the masters in Phase 2.

all.title: Signed in as Admin: every list, total, report and export includes bills without GST, each one marked. Nothing to switch.

all-readonly.title: CA / Auditor: you can read everything and change nothing.

gst.title: You see documents with GST. Lists, totals and exports are made from them.

auth.oneSignIn: One sign-in for both companies. You see the companies your rights allow.
auth.plasticsLine: Moulds, plastic components and assembled plasticware
auth.biochemLine: Bath and Care range, home care and perfumes
auth.mfaPrompt: Password accepted. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
auth.otpHelp: Asked every time for Admin and finance users. Codes on WhatsApp for a new phone arrive with WhatsApp in Phase 3.
auth.forgotPhase: Forgot password? Reset by WhatsApp code · coming in phase 3. Until then, ask Admin.
auth.lockNote: Repeated wrong tries lock the account for a while.
auth.staffPhoneLink: How this looks on a staff phone →

errors.phone: Enter the 10-digit mobile number on WhatsApp, without +91 or 0.
errors.invalid: Number or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
errors.locked: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again, or ask Admin.
errors.phoneDisabled: Sign-in with a WhatsApp number is not switched on yet. Ask Admin.
errors.banned: This account is switched off. Ask Admin.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your signal and try again.
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Try again, or ask Admin.
errors.noFactor: This account has no authenticator set up. Ask Admin.
errors.code: That code is not right. Enter the 6 digits shown in your authenticator app now.
errors.notConfigured: This copy of the app is not connected to the database. Set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

staffSignIn.title: Staff sign in
staffSignIn.sub: Your WhatsApp number and your password.
staffSignIn.forgotPhase: Forgot password? Code on WhatsApp · phase 3. Ask Admin now.
staffSignIn.foot: First time? Admin gives you your password. Stays signed in on this phone.

help.title: Southfield Help
help.intro: Ask in your own language what a screen does, why something is blocked, or what an error means. Help reads with your own rights and never changes data.
help.phase: The help assistant answers from Phase 3.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load this page's figures.
errors.tryAgain: Check your connection and reload. If it happens again, give this reference to Admin.

rules.rights.missing: You don't have the right for this. Ask Admin for it, or for a special permission.
rules.rights.read_only: Read-only access: the CA and auditors can read everything but change nothing.
rules.rights.reason_required: Say why this changes. The reason goes into the user log.
rules.rights.admin_only: That right belongs to Admin only and can't be given to this role.
rules.rights.self_demote: You can't remove your own Admin role. Ask another Admin.
rules.rights.ca_needs_end: CA and auditor access needs an end date.
rules.rights.role_fixed: Admin and CA rights are fixed by their view and can't be edited.
rules.grant.never_grantable: This right can never be given as a special permission.
rules.grant.self: Nobody can give a permission to themselves.
rules.grant.too_long: That is longer than the longest permission Admin allows.
rules.grant.bad_window: The end must be after the start.
rules.sod.self_approval: Nobody approves their own request. Another person must decide it.
rules.org.gstin_pan_mismatch: This GSTIN doesn't carry the company's PAN. Check both numbers on the certificate.
rules.org.gstin_other_company: That GSTIN belongs to another company.
rules.numbering.in_use: Numbers are already issued from this series, so its prefix and counter are locked.
rules.numbering.too_long: The number would be longer than 16 characters. Use a shorter prefix.
rules.users.self_disable: You can't switch off your own account.
rules.unique: That code or number is already used.
rules.grant.already_decided: This request has already been decided.
rules.grant.not_on_list: This right is not on the special permission list.
rules.numbering.no_series: There is no active number series for this document in this financial year. Add one on Numbering & IDs.
rules.request.id_missing: The request had no ID. Reload the page and try again.
rules.auth.required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
rules.mrp.same_date: An MRP already starts on this date. MRP history is never edited; choose the next date.
rules.masters.possible_duplicate: A similar record already exists. Check the list; create anyway only if it really is different.

errors.invalidValue: One of the values is not in the right format. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
errors.nextStep: Fix it and try again. If it keeps happening, give this reference to Admin.
errors.noAccess: You don't have access to this screen. Ask Admin.

kpis.emptyBody: Sales, bank, cash and what customers owe appear here once the companies are set up and the Tally books are loaded.

chart.title: Sales by month
chart.emptyBody: Each month's bill value appears as a bar once invoices are posted or loaded from Tally.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.emptyBody: Open problems — payroll ready, cash limits, bills needing a reason, returns due — appear here, each with a link that fixes it.

bills.title: Latest bills
bills.emptyBody: The latest bills appear here once invoices are posted (Phase 3) or loaded from Tally (Phase 2).
bills.noteAll: Admin is signed in, so bills without GST are here, marked. Anyone else opening this page sees the bills with GST and totals made from them only.
bills.noteGst: You see bills with GST, and totals made from them.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Customers of the company you choose · each starts as a draft for KYC
customers.subtitleEmpty: Customers come from Customer KYC and the Tally load · each starts as a draft for KYC
customers.adminNote: You are Admin: you can add, edit any field and remove. Other users follow the rights Admin gives them.
customers.rightsNote: You see and change customers as your rights allow. Ask Admin for more.
customers.emptyBody: Add a customer, or load the customer masters from Tally.
customers.emptyBodyPhase: The customer master is built in Phase 2: Customer KYC with GSTIN checks, and the Tally load without duplicates.
customers.foot: Names as the bank or Tally shows them; Edit fixes the spelling and adds GSTIN, address and contacts. A party under more than one name is merged into one.

removeCard.title: What Remove does
removeCard.noDocsLead: No invoices, receipts or orders yet:
removeCard.noDocs: the customer is removed. The user log keeps who removed it and when.
removeCard.withDocs: Remove becomes Deactivate (no new orders or invoices) or Merge into another customer. Their past invoices stay, because the books must keep them.

editCard.title: Edit any field
editCard.p1: Admin can change any field, on any customer, at any time. Each change keeps the old and new value, who changed it and when.
editCard.p2: A changed GSTIN or state applies to new invoices; invoices already issued are corrected with a credit note and a new invoice.

home.subPending: Staff record set up in Phase 3
home.payEmpty: No payslip yet. Your pay shows here once payroll runs.
home.noRequests: No requests yet. Answers come here and on WhatsApp.

phone.offline: Offline · sends when back in signal

planned.title: Planned screen
planned.subtitle: Built in phase {{phase}} of the plan
planned.emptyBody: Its tables, rules and posting functions are built in that phase, then the screen is wired to live data. Nothing here is a mock-up.
planned.phoneBody: This part of the app is built in a later phase.
